sam: Postmortem follow-up: collecting owners for the rollout safety items we discussed. Short bullets please.

nina: I'll take blast-radius enforcement (per-flag active-user cap + per-shard ceiling). Target 2025-03-18.

omar: I'll own the auto-rollback controller and alert wiring. Plan: implement rollback + scale-down ordering, add integration test for DB pressure. Target 2025-03-11.

ci-bot: system: detected canary run 2025-02-24T14:02Z  shards=3 concurrency=210 sample=0.04

sam: Observed recurring pattern: high per-shard concurrency -> hotspotting -> downstream saturation -> 5xx. Short-term defaults: prod concurrency_default=25, non-prod=120.

nina: For per-flag caps I'll include per-customer opt-out flow and a legal checklist. Will post design doc next week.

omar: Auto-rollback triggers proposal: if p95 > 1.8s OR 5xx_rate > 0.8% sustained for 2m -> try scale-down once (reduce concurrency by 50%), if still above threshold after 30s -> rollback.

product-bot: note: please include customer notification language for auto-rollback in the product doc.

sam: I'll create the GH board "rollout-guardrails" and a recurring Friday triage. Label all tasks `rollout-guardrail`.

nina: I'll add telemetry checks: shard entropy, per-shard qps, and active-user counts; alert if distribution skew > threshold.

omar: I'll open RFC + initial PR and wire the pager. Will link CI integration test simulating DB queueing.

sam: Recap owners & dates: auto-rollback (omar) 2025-03-11, blast-radius caps (nina) 2025-03-18, rollout defaults + board (sam) 2025-03-06. If no objections I'll add to the postmortem and close.

nina: Ack.

omar: Ack.

sam: Closing; will ping when board is live.
